definition: to notice something through the skin
description: A young woman in a black swimsuit stands waist-deep in milky blue water in a steaming outdoor hot spring while snow falls. With her eyes closed and her head tilted up, she holds out her open hands to catch the snowflakes, lowers her hands to the water, breathes out and lifts them again. Flakes land on her eyelashes, wet hair and bare shoulders, and steam rises around her. Snow-covered black lava rocks and a white hillside fade into the mist behind her.
